meaning: A way to open your phone by looking at it. The phone checks that your face matches the one it saved.
clues: It uses the front camera of your phone to see you.
You do not have to remember or type anything.
When you set it up, the phone saved a model of your face.
A mask or sunglasses can sometimes make it fail.
It has two words. The first has four letters and starts with F.
assumes: A fingerprint unlock uses a sensor you touch
A security question asks you to answer in words

decoys.meaning: A way to open a phone by touching a sensor. The phone checks that your fingerprint matches the one it saved.
A personal question you pick when you set up an account, like your first pet's name. You answer it later to prove who you are.
A short code sent to you for one sign-in only. It stops working after a few minutes.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, the guard at the door knew your face. Now your phone is the guard. I am impressed.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: It is handy, but it can fail. Keep a strong passcode as a backup so you are never locked out.

blank.sentence: My phone opened as soon as I looked at it, because I use ___.

why: The phone checks that your face matches the one it saved.
short: Phone opens when it sees you
